data.name: Plugin_Description
data.value: Batch tasks for ICU MessageFormat messages in JSON and Java properties files: expand plural forms into one segment per CLDR category the target language needs, and finalise the translated messages before target generation.

data.name: Task_Expand_Description
data.value: Expands ICU plural and selectordinal arguments into one translatable segment per CLDR category required by the target language, each a complete sentence with a comment naming the counts that select it.

data.name: Task_Finalise_Description
data.value: Prunes plural branches to the target language's CLDR set, escapes ICU special characters typed as text and checks placeholder parity, ready for target generation.

data.name: ViewPart_Forms_Description
data.value: Every form of the ICU message the active segment belongs to, with sample counts, the reassembled message and whether it is valid.

data.name: Action_ShowForms_Description
data.value: Show the ICU Forms window under the editor.

data.name: Verifier_Description
data.value: Checks every form of an expanded ICU message: untranslated forms, placeholders that differ from the source, a count marker typed as text, and a message that will not parse.
